route: atelier composition, not the 11-stage pipeline (skills/creative/ink-theater.md declares the style pipeline-exempt)
mechanism: Both feet sit at the same potential, so no current flows; danger comes from bridging two conductors.
decisions: Voltage is drawn as ELEVATION. The middle section re-reads the street as terrain so the wire can be shown to be flat, which is the whole mechanism.
The accent is embargoed: red means a potential difference, so there is no red in the film until 29.6s — the logo wears grey and the subscribe card wears ink.
The charge is a ball. It sits perfectly still for eleven seconds, then accelerates at s=f^2 down the step; the sound follows the same curve.
Two audio buses ducked differently (ambience 0.86, the film's own events 0.34). The first mix ducked the arc under the narration and buried the one bang in the film.
The wire hums at 50Hz from frame one and grows a 100Hz buzz when the step appears: the same oscillator opens rather than a new sound arriving.
faults_found_and_fixed: The wires were at his head height: the bird sat on his hair and the picture said he was touching 11kV. Wires up, SCALE 1.42 -> 1.36.
The step appeared 80px clear of the bird, which draws the opposite claim. The riser now goes under its right foot and a second drawing has the leg reaching the lower conductor.
His hand closed on air 80px above the signpost he was supposed to be holding.
A 1.16 zoom on the street put the kerb line through the last two captions.
The last caption was three lines: y=1466, under the Shorts title block. Every caption is now two lines and under ~34 characters.

THE CONTACT STRIP: nine seconds of a motionless bird in the close-up and twelve more in the diagram. A still cannot show you that nothing is moving. Fixed with liveBird(): breath, a head flick hashed off t, and one sideways hop along the same wire.
